exact_statement: For any Boolean function class C containing constants and literals and closed under sign reversal, physical coordinate restrictions, disjoint Boolean products and point activation on fresh controls, for every Boolean f and integers t,r>=1, membership of f in C is equivalent to membership of g_t=z*product_{j=1}^t f(x^(j)) and equivalent to membership of 1+A_r(g_t-1). Furthermore, Let R consist of Boolean signs with finite globally read-once AND/OR/parity/negation formula certificates, literal or constant leaves and no opaque Boolean leaves. R is closed under restrictions, sign reversal, disjoint substitution, disjoint products, balancing and point activation on fresh controls. Every f in R satisfies corrected product-biased E(f)<=C0*(I(f)-Var(f)), C0=2+4/ln(2), and H(f)<=C0*I(f) for uniform original inputs. The balanced three-bit multiplexer M(x,y,z)=(1+x)y/2+(1-x)z/2 and all its activated balanced tensor powers are outside R. Overlapping OR substitution does not preserve R. For the control-first r-bit point activation of a fresh literal y, with p=2^(-r), the expected control depth D=2(1-p), I_sel=rp, I=p(r+1), and the uncompressed two-bits-per-query transcript has cost/I=4(2^r-1)/(r+1), tending to infinity. Every exact finite spectral witness W retaining its physical leaf label satisfies H(W|S)>=D-H(F)>=2(1-p)-4rp-2p*log2(e), whose displayed lower bound tends to two bits.
hypotheses: Uniform cubes of arbitrary finite dimension
Fresh independent blocks and sign z
A_r is a single-point indicator on r fresh controls
All five class hypotheses are required
Each original input label occurs at most once globally
Arbitrary finite gate fan-in and depth
Product inputs for corrected E; uniform inputs for H/I
Delete deterministic children before dividing by child variance
